The vine is the door, the grove the key, the bridge the lock's memory — and the lock remembers every opening the farm would rather forget. The evidence is timestamped, so a proof minted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. Making one clone takes 132 POA and 28 minutes; keeping 238 of them alive costs 31416 POA and 6664 minutes every epoch. Records do not forget and prices do not bend; the farm fails on both counts.
